KayKit - Forest Nature Pack

The Forest Nature Pack is a bundle of game assets that contains 200+ unique (1500+ total models including recolours) stylised forest assets like trees, bushes, rocks, grass and terrain. Most of which is free! They're great for adding a little bit of green to your game, make a lush forest, or just spruce up the place.

Contents

  • Trees in varying styles in various sizes and configurations..
  • Bushes in varying styles in various sizes and configurations.
